12. Shift from AI-First to Database-First
Stop relying on AI for every practice request.

AI should become a content creation tool, not the content delivery engine.

Generate questions once.

Store them permanently.

Serve questions directly from the database.

Use AI only when:

A new chapter or topic needs to be added.

The repository requires expansion.

A suitable question is unavailable in the database.

Business Rationale
Reduce recurring AI costs.

Improve response speed.

Increase platform scalability.

Keep the ₹349 subscription financially sustainable.

Core Principle
AI is for creating the question bank, not for serving every student request. Once the repository is mature, the database should power the learning experience, with AI used only to fill gaps and expand content.
